+-- Migration 067: Official accounts (ACME) + boosters (LOT 6).
+-- Date: 2026-06-02
+-- Purpose: "Mise en relation" pivot, LOT 6 — two mechanisms:
+--   A) Official accounts: members flagged is_official are force-injected into every
+--      eligible member's weekly task as a LOCKED Connecter/Contacter target on the
+--      networks they share (handled in the scoring engine). Official members are
+--      kept out of the normal peer pool.
+--   B) Boosters: admin-managed, time-windowed spotlights of a member's network
+--      profile, injected for every member on platforms they LACK (single Contacter
+--      + NON). end_week NULL = permanent (e.g. the ACME headline).
+
+-- ── A) Official flag ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+ALTER TABLE members
+  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_official boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN members.is_official IS
+  'Official account (e.g. ACME). Injected as a LOCKED action on shared networks; '
+  'excluded from the normal peer candidate pool and never generates its own tasks.';
+
+-- ── B) Boosters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS boosters (
+  id                     uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+  -- The member network profile to spotlight (carries platform + profile_url + owner).
+  member_social_media_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES member_social_medias(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  label                  text,
+  -- Active window (ISO week). NULL start = active immediately; NULL end = permanent.
+  start_week             integer,
+  start_year             integer,
+  end_week               integer,
+  end_year               integer,
+  is_active              boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
+  created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+COMMENT ON TABLE boosters IS
+  'Admin-managed, time-windowed spotlights (LOT 6 mechanism B). Injected at generation '
+  'into every member''s weekly task on platforms they lack. end_year/end_week NULL = permanent.';
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_boosters_active ON boosters(is_active) WHERE is_active;
+
+ALTER TABLE boosters ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- Only admins manage boosters; the scoring engine reads them via the service role.
+CREATE POLICY "Admins manage boosters"
+  ON boosters FOR ALL
+  USING (is_admin())
+  WITH CHECK (is_admin());
